UnitStatement: Module core/security/redaction/controls.py provides bounded local redaction controls for report/export representations.
Redaction functions operate on already-parsed dictionaries/lists and return a redacted copy without mutating the source payload.
Redaction functions do not read files, move quarantine material, transmit data, or infer sensitivity from value text.
PUBLIC_CONTEXTS comprises public_report, public_example, shared_model, and downstream_tool; EXPORT_CONTEXTS adds local_private.
SAFE_PRIVACY_CLASSES are public, public_metadata, and invented_public_example.

PRIVATE_PRIVACY_CLASSES include private_project_data, private_material_data, private_component_data, private_rule_pack_data, owner_standard_data, company_design_basis_data, path_data, and secret_like_data.

PAYLOAD_DETAIL_KEYS, SECRET_MATERIAL_KEYS, CONCRETE_PATH_DETAIL_KEYS, CLOUD_NETWORK_DETAIL_KEYS, and DIRECT_SQL_DETAIL_KEYS define the unsafe detail keys (UNSAFE_DETAIL_KEYS) stripped during redaction.

RedactionDecision is a frozen dataclass capturing decision_id, path, field_class, privacy_classification, redistribution_status, review_status, export_context, action, reason_code, and source_metadata_present.
RedactionFinding is a frozen dataclass with finding_id, code, class_, severity, path, action, message, and remediation; as_schema_dict renames class_ to class.
RedactionResult holds payload, decisions, and findings; blocked is true when any decision action is block_export.
redact_export_payload returns a redacted export/report representation plus findings, basing sensitivity decisions only on explicit metadata fields.
A value-bearing object without metadata is treated as unresolved and is redacted or blocked according to the export context.
redact_export_payload raises ValueError when export_context is not in EXPORT_CONTEXTS.
classify_export_item classifies a single metadata-bearing export item, raising ValueError on unsupported export_context.
_is_value_bearing treats an item as value-bearing when it has a value or text key, explicit metadata, or unsafe item detail.
_action_for blocks export on professional_claim, cloud/network reference, direct SQL access, storage bypass, secret material, or payload presence.
_action_for redacts the value when a concrete path is present (reason CONCRETE_PATH_REDACTED).
_action_for blocks export for protected_suspected privacy/redistribution and for quarantined or rejected review status (PROTECTED_CONTENT_BLOCKED).
Items with safe privacy class and public redistribution status are included, tagged SAFE_INVENTED_PUBLIC_EXAMPLE or SAFE_PUBLIC_METADATA.

Private data in a local_private context is allowed only with a warning when explicit_local_private_intent is set; otherwise it is blocked (LOCAL_PRIVATE_INTENT_REQUIRED) or redacted for non-local contexts.
_unknown_action returns warning_only for local_private export context and redact_value otherwise.
_finding_for maps reason codes to a finding class and severity (BLOCKING for block_export, else WARNING), returning None for include actions.
_apply_action redacts value/text fields to REDACTED_VALUE and sets privacy_classification to redacted for redact_value and block_export actions.
_without_unsafe_detail returns a copy of the item with UNSAFE_DETAIL_KEYS removed.
Package core/security/secret_private_library provides local-first secret and private-library reference controls.
The secret_private_library package __all__ re-exports GuardDecision, GuardResult, ReferenceRecord, classify_reference, guard_reference_release, and related symbols from controls.
Module secret_private_library/controls.py provides deterministic local-first controls for secret/private-library references, handling metadata records only.
The control never reads referenced files, stores credential values or private-library payloads, moves quarantine material, contacts a service, or makes rights/professional determinations.

RELEASE_CONTEXTS combine PUBLIC_RELEASE_CONTEXTS (public_report, public_example, public_fixture, shared_model, downstream_tool) and LOCAL_RELEASE_CONTEXTS (local_private, private_registry, private_diagnostic).
REFERENCE_KINDS comprise PRIVATE_LIBRARY_KINDS, PRIVATE_PATH_KINDS (private_path, private_path_reference), and SECRET_KINDS (secret_field, secret_field_reference, credential_placeholder).

PAYLOAD_KEYS, SECRET_MATERIAL_KEYS, CONCRETE_PATH_DETAIL_KEYS, CLOUD_NETWORK_DETAIL_KEYS, DIRECT_SQL_DETAIL_KEYS, STORAGE_BYPASS_KEYS, and EXTERNAL_SECRET_MANAGER_KEYS define unsafe-detail marker sets.
SYMBOLIC_REFERENCE_LOCALITIES enumerate the allowed symbolic storage-locality tokens such as USER_PRIVATE_LIBRARY_ROOT, USER_SECRET_REFERENCE, and LOCAL_CACHE_ROOT.
GuardDiagnostic is a frozen dataclass with code, severity, path, message, and remediation fields.

ReferenceRecord is a frozen dataclass holding metadata-only reference fields including reference_id, record_kind, storage_locality, privacy_classification, redistribution_status, checksum, and unsafe-detail flags, defaulting value_descriptor to metadata_reference_only.
ReferenceRecord.metadata_dict returns a metadata-only view and, when concrete_path_present, withholds concrete-path detail by substituting concrete_path_detail_withheld.
ReferenceClassification is a frozen dataclass carrying classification_id, default_posture, diagnostics, and metadata; blocked is true when any diagnostic is BLOCKING.
GuardDecision is a frozen dataclass with decision_id, reference_id, record_kind, release_context, action, reason_code, and metadata_only.
GuardResult holds release_context, decisions, diagnostics, and safe_manifest; blocked is true when any decision action is block_release.
GuardResult.summary reports counts and asserts concrete_paths_emitted, cloud_transmission_attempted, external_secret_manager_used, and professional_claims_made are all False.
private_library_reference builds a metadata-only private-library reference record, deriving privacy class from the library kind and recording unresolved TBD items.
private_path_reference builds a symbolic private-path reference record, withholding concrete-path detail when the path class looks concrete.
secret_field_reference builds a secret-like field record that carries no usable value, using a placeholder_key_id descriptor.
credential_placeholder builds an opaque credential placeholder record with secret_material_present set to False.
classify_reference classifies one reference using only explicit metadata, assigning a stable classification id and a default posture.
classify_references classifies references in input order with deterministic per-record IDs.
guard_reference_release returns guard decisions and a metadata-only manifest for references, raising ValueError on unsupported release_context.

_normalize_reference converts a mapping into a ReferenceRecord, detecting payload, secret, concrete-path, cloud/network, external-secret-manager, direct-SQL, and storage-bypass markers, and withholding unsafe detail when present.
_classification_diagnostics emits a WARNING when the reference kind is unknown.
Secret-like material in a reference record produces the BLOCKING diagnostic SECRET_MATERIAL_REFERENCE_ONLY_REQUIRED.
Cloud or network reference metadata produces the BLOCKING diagnostic CLOUD_OR_NETWORK_REFERENCE_BLOCKED, keeping handling local-only unless a later approved workflow authorizes an exception.
External secret-manager metadata produces the BLOCKING diagnostic EXTERNAL_SECRET_MANAGER_BLOCKED until credential-store integration is separately approved.
Direct SQL or raw SQLite interface metadata produces the BLOCKING diagnostic DIRECT_SQL_ACCESS_BLOCKED, requiring application-service persistence boundaries.
Storage-bypass metadata produces the BLOCKING diagnostic STORAGE_BYPASS_BLOCKED, requiring routing through local-first storage, redaction, provenance, and application-service controls.
Concrete path-like detail is withheld and produces the WARNING diagnostic CONCRETE_PATH_REDUCED_TO_SAFE_METADATA, favoring symbolic path classes or opaque local references.
Payload data present in a private-library, private-path, or other reference record produces a BLOCKING payload-reference-only-required diagnostic requiring metadata-only storage.
Unresolved redistribution status, privacy classification, or source/provenance state each produce a WARNING diagnostic requiring resolution before release.
A quarantined or rejected review status produces the BLOCKING diagnostic REVIEW_DISPOSITION_BLOCKED.
Reference metadata indicating protected_suspected status produces the BLOCKING diagnostic PROTECTED_SOURCE_SUSPECTED, routing for human review and keeping it out of public artifacts.

_guard_action blocks release in priority order for secret material, cloud/network, external secret manager, direct SQL, storage bypass, payload presence, blocking review status, and protected-suspected status.
In public release contexts, private data with unknown redistribution is blocked (UNKNOWN_REDIS_PRIVATE_DATA_BLOCKED) and unknown privacy is blocked (UNKNOWN_PRIVACY_PUBLIC_BLOCKED).
Private references are blocked from public_fixture contexts (PRIVATE_REFERENCE_PUBLIC_FIXTURE_BLOCKED) and otherwise included metadata-only in public contexts.
In local contexts, private references require explicit_local_private_intent (else LOCAL_PRIVATE_INTENT_REQUIRED) and are then included metadata-only.

_default_posture returns blocked_until_reference_only_metadata when any diagnostic is BLOCKING, local_private_metadata_only for private records, public_metadata_allowed for public classes, else review_required.
_is_private_library, _is_private_path, and _is_secret classify a record by its record_kind against the corresponding kind sets.
_is_private treats a record as private when its kind, privacy class, redistribution status, or storage locality is private.
_looks_concrete_path flags strings that start with /, ~/, or \\, contain :/ or :\, start with file:// or sqlite://, or end with .sqlite/.sqlite3/.db.
_stable_id derives a deterministic ID by sha256-hashing canonical JSON of the payload and taking the first 16 hex digits with a prefix.
Package core/security/telemetry_policy provides metadata-only telemetry policy guard helpers.
The telemetry_policy package __all__ re-exports TelemetryConfig, TelemetryDecision, TelemetryGuardResult, guard_telemetry_event, and resolve_telemetry_config from controls.
Module telemetry_policy/controls.py provides metadata-only telemetry guard controls resolving telemetry configuration and event attempts.
The telemetry guard does not construct telemetry payloads, open network transports, select vendors, start queues, or persist telemetry data.
APPROVED_OPERATIONAL_FIELD_CLASSES are operational_metadata, public_metadata, and low_sensitivity_metadata.
CONFIG_KEYS enumerate the supported telemetry config keys including enabled, explicit_opt_in, consent_surface, approved_consent_surfaces, allowlist_approved, and event_allowlist.
RUNTIME_SURFACE_KEYS (endpoint, vendor, transport, queue, persistence, upload, etc.) are forbidden runtime transport/persistence surfaces in telemetry config.
PAYLOAD_SHAPED_KEYS (content, payload, raw, text, value, values, etc.) mark payload-shaped data not allowed before guard approval.
FORBIDDEN_FIELD_CLASS_TOKENS list classes (private/protected/secret/path/report/professional/company_design_basis/etc.) that telemetry may never carry.
FORBIDDEN_FIELD_MARKERS and FORBIDDEN_EVENT_MARKERS list substrings (secret, credential, path, model, report, rule, private, protected, etc.) that bar a field name or event name from telemetry.
TelemetryDiagnostic is a frozen dataclass with code, severity, message, remediation, and optional event_name and field_name (defaulting to TBD).

TelemetryConfig is a frozen dataclass holding enabled, requested_enabled, explicit_opt_in, consent_surface, approved_consent_surfaces, allowlist_approved, event_allowlist, diagnostics, and reason_code.
TelemetryConfig.as_schema_dict reports all runtime surfaces (network_transport, endpoint, vendor, upload_queue, persistence, external_service_client) as not initialized.
TelemetryEventAttempt is a frozen dataclass with event_name, field_names, field_classes, event_version, source_surface, and metadata_only (default True).
TelemetryDecision is a frozen dataclass with decision_id, event_name, action, reason_code, allowed_field_names, rejected_field_names, payload_constructed, and network_behavior_initialized.
TelemetryGuardResult holds config, attempt, decision, diagnostics, and safe_metadata; blocked is true when the decision action is not allow_metadata_event.
resolve_telemetry_config resolves telemetry config to an operational default-off state.
Absent telemetry configuration is disabled with reason telemetry_config_absent (INFO TEL-CONFIG-ABSENT).
Malformed (non-mapping) telemetry configuration is disabled with reason telemetry_config_malformed.
Empty telemetry configuration is disabled with reason telemetry_config_empty.

Unknown config keys emit a WARNING (TEL-CONFIG-UNKNOWN); runtime-surface keys emit a BLOCKING diagnostic (TEL-CONFIG-RUNTIME-SURFACE) forbidding endpoints, vendors, transports, queues, upload jobs, or persistence.
The enabled state must be an explicit boolean; otherwise telemetry is disabled as malformed (TEL-CONFIG-MALFORMED-ENABLED).
Any BLOCKING or WARNING diagnostic forces enabled=False with reason telemetry_config_malformed or telemetry_config_unknown.
When telemetry is not requested enabled, config returns disabled with reason telemetry_disabled_by_config.
Enabled telemetry that fails gate checks returns disabled with reason telemetry_gates_incomplete; passing all gates returns enabled with reason telemetry_enabled_metadata_only.
guard_telemetry_event evaluates a telemetry event attempt before payload construction, resolving config and normalizing the attempt.
A malformed/absent event attempt yields a drop_event decision with reason telemetry_event_malformed.
When telemetry is disabled, the event is dropped locally (TEL-EVENT-DROPPED-DISABLED) with the config's reason code.
An event attempt that includes payload-shaped data before guard approval is BLOCKING (TEL-EVENT-PAYLOAD-SHAPED) with reason telemetry_payload_attempt_before_guard.
An event name referring to a forbidden private/protected/report/rule/secret class is BLOCKING (TEL-EVENT-FORBIDDEN-CLASS) and dropped.
An event name absent from the human-approved allowlist is BLOCKING (TEL-EVENT-NOT-ALLOWLISTED) with reason telemetry_event_not_allowlisted.
Field names not in the event allowlist (TEL-FIELD-NOT-ALLOWLISTED) or referring to forbidden classes (TEL-FIELD-FORBIDDEN) are BLOCKING and rejected.
An allowlisted event with allowed fields produces safe_metadata and an allow_metadata_event decision (reason telemetry_metadata_event_allowlisted) with no payload constructed by the guard.
_resolve_existing_config re-validates an existing enabled TelemetryConfig against allowlist and gate diagnostics, disabling it on any blocking/warning condition.
_gate_diagnostics emit BLOCKING diagnostics when enabled telemetry lacks explicit opt-in, an approved consent surface, allowlist approval, or any allowlist entry.
_normalize_allowlist normalizes the event allowlist, dropping malformed events/fields and BLOCKING any allowlist entry containing a forbidden field class.
_normalize_event_attempt converts an attempt into a TelemetryEventAttempt, deriving metadata_only from absence of payload-shaped data and validating event/field names.
_contains_payload_shape recursively detects PAYLOAD_SHAPED_KEYS in mappings, lists, or tuples.
_forbidden_event_reason flags an event name containing any FORBIDDEN_EVENT_MARKER as telemetry_forbidden_event_class.
_forbidden_field_reason blocks a field by forbidden class token (telemetry_forbidden_field_class) or by forbidden name marker (telemetry_forbidden_field_name).
_normalize_marker_text lowercases a value and collapses non-alphanumeric runs into single underscores for marker matching.
Crate open_pipe_stress_canonical_json provides RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON serialization shared by every OpenPipeStress hash seam.
canonical_json depends on serde_json and ryu, using ryu for ECMAScript-equal shortest round-trip float rendering because the std formatter breaks ties differently.
Crate canonical_json is the single canonical-JSON text authority (completion-plan row H5, DEC-010 JCS-compatible hashing baseline) so every JSON-hashing surface renders identical canonical bytes.
RFC 8785 conformance: object keys sorted by UTF-16 code units (§3.2.3); strings escaped exactly as ECMAScript JSON.stringify (§3.2.2.2) via serde_json.
Numbers render in ECMAScript Number::toString shortest round-trip decimal form (§3.2.2.3) with -0 rendered as 0; digit selection comes from ryu (closest shortest candidate, ties to even).

One documented divergence: serde_json preserves i64/u64 integers exactly, so integers beyond 2^53 keep full precision rather than collapsing to the nearest IEEE double; such values cannot arrive distinct through a JavaScript lane since JSON.parse rounds first.
canonical_json(value: &Value) -> String renders a JSON value as RFC 8785 canonical JSON text.
write_canonical emits null/true/false literals, numbers via canonical_number, strings via serde_json, arrays in order, and objects with keys sorted by UTF-16 code units.
Per RFC 8785 §3.2.3, property names sort as arrays of UTF-16 code units (ECMAScript string comparison), not as Unicode code points, which differ for supplementary-plane keys.
canonical_number renders integer-repr numbers via serde's exact rendering and float-repr numbers via the ECMAScript Number::toString algorithm.
ecma_number_to_string implements ECMAScript Number::toString (ECMA-262 §6.1.6.1.20, radix 10) for finite doubles, asserting the value is finite and rendering -0 as 0.

ecma_number_to_string sources shortest round-trip digits from ryu, which selects the same digit string ECMAScript engines do; the std formatter diverged in 7 of 20k random doubles and cannot be the digit source.

ECMA-262 notation expresses value = s x 10^(n-k), where s is the k-digit shortest integer significand and n positions the decimal point; branches cover integer, fractional, leading-zero, and exponential forms (plain decimal for n in (-7,21], else exponential).
shortest_digits extracts the significand digits (no leading/trailing zeros) and the decimal exponent of the first digit from a ryu-rendered positive finite float.
Test rfc8785_appendix_b_bit_pattern_vectors verifies 13 RFC 8785 Appendix B bit-pattern vectors against node JSON.stringify (verified 2026-06-11).
Test ecma_notation_branch_vectors verifies 16 literal vectors across every ECMAScript notation branch against node JSON.stringify (verified 2026-06-11).
Test float_and_integer_repr_converge confirms float-repr (200.0), integer-repr (200), and in-process f64 values render the same canonical bytes.
Test integers_beyond_2_53_keep_exact_precision confirms u64/i64 integers beyond 2^53 keep exact precision (outside the I-JSON envelope).
Test objects_sort_keys_by_utf16_code_units confirms keys sort by UTF-16 code units so a surrogate-pair key precedes a BMP key, unlike code-point order.
Test strings_escape_exactly_as_json_stringify confirms two-character escapes where defined, lowercase \u00xx for other control characters, and literal non-ASCII characters (RFC 8785 §3.2.2.2).
Test composite_document_matches_ecmascript_rendering pins a composite document against node JSON.stringify(sortedDeep(value)) output.
Crate open_pipe_stress_solver_diagnostics provides code-neutral solver diagnostics for OpenPipeStress.
solver_diagnostics depends on the frame_kernel, linear_supports, primitive_loads, and sparse_direct crates.

The solver diagnostics crate is the bounded implementation slice for DEL-04-06, providing code-neutral solver diagnostic records for frame-kernel failures, sparse skyline solver failures, conditioning warnings, nonconvergence, invalid restraints, and explicit sparse-solver adoption-status and tolerance-policy TBD states.
Scope: deterministic diagnostic codes, severities, sources, and solver status values.
Scope: diagnostic envelope fields for PKG-02 result-boundary integration including diagnostic class, remediation, provenance, optional canonical model reference, and optional unit metadata.
Scope: solver-status mapping to the PKG-02 analysis-boundary mechanics status and authority fields.
Scope: mapping FrameKernelError into diagnostic records, including invalid frame orientation as blocking model topology.

Scope: mapping SparseDirectError into diagnostic records; singular pivots are failures located in both profile-ordered and original reduced-DOF numbering (stable reduced-dof:<n> references), and invalid numeric inputs are blocking.
Scope: deterministic diagnostics from sparse LDLᵀ factorization reports, including a NonPositivePivot warning with count and first location when the reduced stiffness is not positive definite.
Scope: mapping linear support findings/application errors and primitive load findings into diagnostic records, with stable affected references for primitive-load missing-ID findings.
Scope: basic finite/nonnegative condition-ratio classification serving small verification paths and the sparse pivot-ratio conditioning proxy, with thresholds caller-supplied and governed by D-04.
Scope: nonconvergence diagnostics for iterative methods without implementing nonlinear support behavior.

Scope: explicit status diagnostics where DEC-023 resolves sparse-solver selection (in-repo skyline LDLᵀ) but SparseSolverTbd records that live solve-path adoption remains TBD, and the tolerance-policy TBD diagnostic fires per DEC-026 until governed values are measured.

Boundary: the crate reports mechanics-solver diagnostics only, mapping solver-local statuses to MODEL_INCOMPLETE or MECHANICS_SOLVED under solver_result_only authority and never emitting rule-check or human-acceptance statuses.

Boundary: the crate does not solve models, set final tolerance policy, define conditioning thresholds, perform rule-pack checks, encode protected standards data, or make professional/code-compliance claims.

Verification: unit tests cover singular-system mapping (dense and sparse, ordered/original pivot locations), invalid restraint and prescribed-DOF boundary errors, support and primitive-load mapping, invalid topology, non-finite/ill-conditioning/failed conditioning, nonconvergence, convergence, nonpositive-pivot and clean factorization reports, and the DEC-023-aware sparse-solver status diagnostic.
